scripts.build: rm -rf dist/ && mkdir dist/ && cp appsscript.json public/; pnpm --filter sidebar --filter dialog run --parallel build && mv dialog/dist/index.html dist/dialog.html && mv sidebar/dist/index.html dist/sidebar.html && for f in $(ls -a public/ | tail -n +3); do cp public/$f dist/; done; pnpm -w run build:server && mv server/Code.js dist/Code.gs
scripts.clasp:create: pnpm build && cd dist && clasp create --title Flowcast --type docs && cp appsscript.json .. && cp .clasp.json ../public
scripts.clasp:push: pnpm -w --filter sidebar --filter dialog run --parallel typecheck && pnpm build && cd dist && clasp push
scripts.clasp:dev: pnpm build && cd dist && clasp push
